# Kyo

> Kyo is a Discord music bot that streams music from YouTube, Spotify, and SoundCloud with fast playback and clear audio.

## Pages

- [Home](https://kyobot.voidev.in/): Overview of Kyo, its features, and how to add it to a Discord server.
- [Commands](https://kyobot.voidev.in/commands): Full list of Kyo's commands for playing music, managing queues, and more.
- [Status](https://kyobot.voidev.in/status): Real-time bot status, latency, and uptime.

## Optional

- [Privacy Policy](https://kyobot.voidev.in/privacy): How Kyo handles user data.
- [Terms of Service](https://kyobot.voidev.in/terms): Terms and conditions for using Kyo.
